violation_type.title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers (26 TAC §747.2315(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers
violation_type.typical_finding: During the inspection I observed an infant in a  baby walker.    It corrected at the inspection time.

finding_variants.text: During the inspection I observed an infant in a  baby walker.    It corrected at the inspection time.
The childcare home has a baby walker. This is prohibted equipment and needs to be removed.
In the main area where children will be in care, a baby walker with wheels was observed.  This was corrected when the baby walker was removed from the area.
A 10 month old infant was observed in a play yard with a soft pillow.     Note: Pillow was removed
A baby walker was observed in the child care area.     This was corrected by removing from the premises.
An infant was observed in a baby walker during inspection. This was corrected during inspection as the infant was taken out of the walker.

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: The operation had a walker in the home.       Corrected:  When the walker was removed.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: At the time of the inspection, two baby walkers were observed, with one in use by an infant in care. Both walkers were removed during the inspection.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A baby walker with wheels was observed to be in the play area where children were in care. This was corrected when the baby walker was removed.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: An infant was observed using a baby walker. This was corrected during the inspection when the infant was removed and the walker was placed outside.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: An infant was placed in a baby walker during the inspection.    This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver removed the infant from the baby walker and the operation removed the baby walker
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: An infant was observed seated in a baby walker during inspection. This was corrected at inspection as it was removed from the home.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: The home had a baby walker with wheels. This was corrected when the walker was removed.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: During the inspection an infant was observed in/using a baby walker.     This was corrected at the inspection when the infant was removed and the walker was taken out of the children's area.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: During the inspection two infants were observed using a baby walker on the playground.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A young child was observed utilizing a walker.  The deficiency was corrected during the inspection when CCR brought it to management attention that the walker is prohibited.  The provider immediately moved the young child from the walker and placed the young child on the floor to engage in floor time.  The walker was removed from the activity area.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A baby walker was observed in the classroom.     Note: The baby walker was recmoved from the classroom during the inspection.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: Infant child was sitting in baby walker upon inspectors arrival. This was corrected at inspection by having the caregiver remove the walker from the operation.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A child was playing in a baby walker that had wheels still attached. This was brought into compliance when the child was removed from the equipment.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A walker was in the home. This was corrected at the inspection when it was removed from use.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: The home had an infant in a baby walker which had wheels. This was corrected when the primary caregiver removed the wheels.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: An infant was observed sitting baby walker that had wheels.     This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver removed the equipment.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A 14 month old infant was seen utilizing a walker.  Note: This was corrected when the infant was removed from the walker and the walker was removed from licensed space.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: During the inspection the baby walker was present in the living room.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A 10 month old was observed using a baby walker.    Note: This was corrected when the wheels were taken off the baby walkers.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: An infant was using a walker at the operation.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when infant was removed by caregiver from the walker.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A baby walker was present in the children's activity space during the inspection. This deficiency was corrected at inspection when the baby walker was removed from the home.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: There was a walker that the director stated a parent brought for the use of the infant. The director stated she did not use it. The walker was removed when the parent came to pick up the infant and given to the parent.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: An infant was observed using a baby walker. This was corrected during the inspection when the equipment was removed.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A baby walker was observed in the child care area.     This was corrected by removing from the premises.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: There were two baby walkers in the childcare operation of the home. The provider removed the baby walkers from the area during the monitoring visit.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: There were two baby walkers on the back porch.  One did not have the stopper all the way down, so it could roll  We asked the director about it, and she changed the position of the stopper so it could not roll.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: Observed a baby walker in one of the rooms used by the children that the wheels had been removed. The product was not made to be used without the wheels and could create further safety concerns.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: An infant was observed in a baby walker during inspection. This was corrected during inspection as the infant was taken out of the walker.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: An infant was observed in a baby walker with wheels which is a prohibited item.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A baby walker was observed in the kitchen area of the home.      NOTE:  This was corrected at inspection when the primary caregiver removed it and put it away in a closet.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A 10 month old child was observed using a baby walker at the child care home.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A baby walker was observed at the operation.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: An child was observed in a walker.    This was corrected at inspection when child was removed from the walker and the walker was stored away. Then when parent arrived to pick up child, the walker was returned to parent to keep at home.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: In the main area where children will be in care, a baby walker with wheels was observed.  This was corrected when the baby walker was removed from the area.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: In the course of the inspection, an infant was noticed utilizing a baby walker. The issue was promptly addressed during the inspection as the caregiver promptly intervened, taking the child out of the baby walker and discontinuing its use.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: Inspector observed a 14 month old infant in a walker with wheels.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A 10 month old infant was observed in a play yard with a soft pillow.     Note: Pillow was removed
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: The childcare home has a baby walker. This is prohibted equipment and needs to be removed.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A child was sitting in a walker with wheels.    This was corrected when the walker was removed from the childcare area.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A baby walker was in use.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: There was one baby walker which is prohibited equipment in daycare area using by children.    Note : corrected.    The caregiver removed it to her garage to return to the parent today.    Picture taken.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A baby walker was observed at LCCH and is being used daily for a two year old.      Note:  Baby Walker was removed.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: During the inspection I observed an infant in a  baby walker.    It corrected at the inspection time.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: It was oberved an infant using a baby walker during the inspection. Note: this was corrected during the inspection, when the caregiver removed the equipment.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: There was a baby walker which is prohibited equipment in children's area.    Picture was taken.    Note : corrected.    The caregiver removed it out of children's area and stated that she will not use it for her children in care anymore.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: During the inspection a nine-month-old infant was observed in a baby walker. Infant was removed from baby walker and baby walker was removed from care area.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: Two twelve month old children were observed in baby walkers during this inspection.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A walker had been used by an infant in care. This was corrected at the inspection when it was removed to the trash.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: An infant was put in a baby walker equipped with wheels during the inspection.    Note: The provider removed the infant from the walker during the inspection.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A baby walker was observed in the outdoor area. Caregiver confirmed it is being used by an infant in care.      NOTE: The baby walker was removed from the child care space.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: There was a baby walker equipped with wheels in the room used by children.     Note: The provider removed it during the inspection.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: An infant was observed in a baby walker.    Note: This was corrected when the director removed the walker from the home.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: The provider is allowing an 11 month old child to use a rolling walker. The walker was provided by the parent.

Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: The home had an infant in a baby walker with wheels. This is a prohibited piece of equipment for infants. The infant was moved to another seat during the inspection.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: Observed a 6 month old infant in a baby walker.
Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: The operation has two baby walkers that have been identified as prohibited equipment for infants.
